blinding_limitation: Scores were omitted from the review input, but the protocol and fixed rating-group ordering were available; this is not a fully blinded study.
scope: 20 fixed source cases; 15 available Resolution texts and 5 missing texts

rubric.identifiable_problem_detail: Resolution itself describes an interpretable specific customer or product problem, beyond the supplied categorical subject
rubric.concrete_resolution_action_or_outcome: Resolution itself states an interpretable action taken or outcome connected to the support problem
rubric.explicit_affect_expression: Resolution itself contains an interpretable explicit affect expression, not an isolated generic word
rubric.false: The requested information is not identifiable in the available text; not evidence that the underlying event or feeling was absent
rubric.unclear: Not assessable because Resolution is missing
rubric.attribution: Resolution author is unknown; this review does not attribute any expression to the customer

limitations: This is an AI source-content audit, not a human-validated sentiment ground-truth label set.
The sample deliberately contains five cases per evidence state and is not a prevalence sample.
Missing texts are not counted as semantic negatives.
Findings apply to the 15 available sample texts and do not establish that all 2769 nonempty resolutions lack usable information.
False semantic flags must not be used to infer neutral sentiment or a successfully resolved ticket.
